name: @artifactbin/sql
description: The SQL service: SQLite (the official wasm build), in this process or in one of its own. Rows in, rows out; nothing persists between calls. `.` is the contract, the HTTP client and the server shell; `./shape` is the pure column inference, importable from a browser bundle; `./core` is the browser-safe SQLite engine; `./sqlite` is that engine as a SqlService in the calling thread (a CLI, a test); `./local` is the same engine in a pool of worker threads, for a server.
